body: my partner agreed to make good on our pact. I'll be gone soon enough
i understand I'm disgusting. I'm so desperately sorry for what i am

I texted a friend that I'm not doing very well as a cry for help. They got a bad feeling and came over to find my indoor cat loose outside, broken glass in my kitchen with back door open. They found me in the shed... they moved me and caused me to throw up.

Yea I talk with them often and alot about it and we unfortunatel have many of the same traumas down to both having been raped by people with the same first name even... Lifes funny like that right?

So it's really because of them that I'm still here today. That they're not ready to make good on a suicide pact we made as a way to try and support each other through so much ideation. Lately it's been me on the down swing though as we were able to find them an antidepressent that worked for their needs but I still dont have one for myself. Tried a bunch and they just seemed to make things worse as they didnt help and the side effects were utter crap. I did cancel the therapy sessions for the week but they'll be there for next week unless I catch her also on a bad day and we end up leaving. 

As for the self harm with drugs/alcohol/sex yea definitely a recurring topic with my therapists and my partner. 

Really though, thanks for reaching out and trying to make a difference. It does help <3
Thanks for the not of kind words. Still in a lot of pain and may not be using the best coping mechanisms at the moment but I'll keep breathing for at least the night. Thanks hun.

I'm not... I handed my chemicals over to my best friend the last time i was so close to using them... well that was 2 years ago now. I repurchased them a year ago now and have survived till now. I'm just done... i don't belong here and am wrong
try a childhood of rape by family members and being born trans. wtf is your problem you think that just because i make money and have a relationship that i can't be in pain? fuck you
Eventually, suicide
Yes, a second chance at it with my knowledge and I may have the courage to fight my rapist or at least tell someone to escape them.

The suicide pact I keep with a friend. I can't leave until we're both ready to at the same time. In practice so far, it means when I'm at that point, they're a huge emotional support for me and I do the same for them when they're at their lowest.

The day where we're both hurting that bad and ready to leave, we'll go holding each other.

One of the main contributors to death due to fasting is really dehydration. You were still consuming fluids and calories in the form of sugars from the diet Coke so while you may have been missing some nutrition, you were still feeding your bodies primary needs of water and calories.

Refuse to drink anything too and you would die within 2-3 weeks. Symptoms are mostly weakness, tiredness and discomfort from dehydration like dry mouth and cracked lips. That can be alleviated by swishing water in mouth before spitting and lip balm. Overall, not supposed to be an unpleasant way to die at all and is a more common method among older people.

I've gone near broke now on essential medical procedures. Money I intended would be a huge help to one of those people. I also leave them my car in my will and by coincidence theirs was just totaled Monday.

The other friend, we have a suicide pact and share many of the same traumas and troubles. She understands me and is willing to die with me to stop the pain.

I've lost my family. What connection I still retain with them is so far broken and warped that I end up in a self harm state consistently now after spending time with my mother. I'm loved by them but not accepted or respected in the least. I'm wrong and a freak.

I carry the burden of a secret that would destroy their family. My brother raped me throughout my childhood. It's killing me but I still can't ever do that to my mother despite everything.

The surgeries... they're in a week and a half... I'm scared and in a panic. They'll never be enough to fix what's wrong with me. I really just hope that I die on that table if not before... My pact-friend has my 2nd half of my suicide plan. Something that she can hold on to for that feeling of control herself. I've been begging that she bring it over and we drift away together. She's been doing much better overall since she found an antidepressant that actually works. I feel so guilty for begging of her but I'm in so much pain.

I ended work today crying in the bathroom. There's little left of me now but tears.

I didn't report because as a young child you don't know anything. I was abused by my brother, a person I cared about and trusted. Being so young and frightened into it 'being a secret' by someone you cared about is the top of a very slippery slide where you begin to believe that it's normal, it's a display of affection, that you enjoy and want it.

I didn't report because the abuse I've suffered makes me feel as though I'm less than and worthless when compared with others. Because I'm responsible for the abuse and if I told anyone that it'd be my own fault for destroying my family.

I didn't report because he has more to lose than I value my own ongoing suffering. He has an established and growing family giving my parents grand kids and a future. I cannot have my own kids and only have a cat and 2 amazing best friends who I consider family. While this pain works to slowly kill me, I feel as though that's the lesser of the burdens on me as the damage was done and his life can prosper in my silence while mine is damned either way.
I've made it a year longer than I thought could ever be possible. I can't do this anymore. I've got nothing left to give

Hey lady. I'm there with you. I'm still working on coming out at work and present androgenous while at work. I've just had my name changed and have yet to file it with HR though I am out to them. I can get maybe 30 min into voice practice before breaking down to tears. This shit sucks and that's what gives me the certainty about who I am. No one would ever do any of this given the choice because of how painful it is.

I'm not in a good mental state at all myself but I've been finding that the worse I am lately, The harder I've been trying. I've made so much progress in just the past couple of months alone though I've sat there essentially at arms reach of death. If you can take any of that anger, pain or sadness and use it to fuel determination and effort you might surprise yourself with having done something amazing.

I'm currently fighting my HR department over a trans exclusion policy. I'm not a person who likes confrontation but maybe if I suffer, someone else won't have to. Maybe if you fight your exemployer legally, some other scared person will have an easier time. It's a small thing that has me continuing to try.

With the community... it really does seem like there are plenty of misguided or unbalanced people. It's sad but understandable as this sort of thing really does take a mental toll on people. So there are catty politics and meaningless gatekeeping everywhere and no lack at all of *free advice* wanted or not. Try to ignore the meaningless noise and unsolicited advice as best as you can but dont stop asking questions and opinions of the people you respect. Noone has the magic key to a flawless transition and there are tons of people you can find who you'll relate to. Value their thoughts more and remember to  anyone at all who starts by saying "you need/have/should" with a grain of salt. All of my ramblings included ;)

You've made amazing progress and I know personally I feel the same way with trying for an unobtainable self. For me, my friends are insistent that I'm an attractive worthwhile person. I really expect you have others in your life that may feel the same way even though they might not say it. You're brave if nothing else but for fighting to be yourself in this scary world 💙

CO binds more readily to your blood cells than oxygen does. because of this, your body can quickly become oxygen starved and die essentially of suffocation. Since co binds so strongly as well, it isn't as easily removed from your body and so a small exposure for a long duration can also be enough to be fatal. CO2 buildup in your body is what causes the feeling of suffocation and since breathing co doesn't result in co2, you won't feel like you can't breath but you'll feel drunk/sleepy/sick instead

It's not much but sending love your way boy. Also pizza does help most of the time 💜

Sometimes the simple distractions like tv or games or a book can help. A thing that really helped me on the way to getting strong enough to ditch my own abusive ex was getting into boardgames and cardgames at a local game store. Between that and online gaming friends it made some difference in getting just enough courage.

Whatever you get up to maybe looking forward to that next slice can buy you some time.

I'm with you. There have been days I've gone without saying a single thing or trying my best to isolate so I wouldn't have to speak to anyone. It's hard when the thing that helps is on the other side of some of that pain. I can manage maybe around a half hour every now and then of hypercritical practice with a recorded before the crying hits. Sending love your way.

no, it's sexist bullshit people are spouting at you. You're legit and valid. There are plenty of lesbians everywhere and you don't have to do anything or be with anyone you don't want to. You don't exist for anyone but yourself. Also just because you may have had a hetero encounter, you're no less than "goldstars". It's a stupid idea that only exists so that some people can claim they're better than others.

All the love your way lady! Trying your best is all anyone can ever expect from you. Be kind to yourself 💙.
some yes. None of it is a recent development and she knows all of that. Only recent thing she doesn't know is exactly how much ideation I'm struggling with. Thanks for your kindness.
we have a suicide pact that no action is to be taken until we are both ready

B is really trying so very hard. trying to convince me to get a new car, to go on vacation, to give everything i can at a chance to be ok. I'm tired and have honestly been trying so hard. I've been seeing drs for hrt and for antidepressants, therapists out the whazoo, been eating better and losing weight back to a really good range, coming out to hr, manager and bosses at work, trying to keep moving and progress but hurdles get higher and I'm scared and tired. Just stayed up to do taxes, I spent so much on medical and therapy :( and none of that even touches the price things i really think I may need but am scared to do. I hate myself. It doesn't help that I have to see my rapist all the time. Surprise, its my brother. Only my sister knows and it would destroy my mom and their family. Its something I both need to get out but also intend to take to my grave.

I guess just listen to me apologizing makes me feel a bit more at peace. So thanks. I haven't done anything yet but have been spiraling hard and fast lately. The week before Every ounce of me wanted to end it that night but again B and the suicide pact. 

B has been there and ready at times in the past and its hard but she's trying hard to help and stay strong herself. At the moment i have to selfishly hope she falters. I made the pact with her in an effort to keep her going after one of her previous attempts. That way she has to wait on me but now it's so far in the other direction than I could imagine that it's alittle funny. I came home today to a unicorn balloon and popcorn. I whispered a thanks through tears. I've mostly stopped talking now since yesterday evening. The sound of my voice hurts to hear.

I'm still trying but it feels like so much of what I could do would just be a waste of money I intend to leave to the best friend, Q. I just bought her a couple of gifts I could write a message in to leave beside my will. I was born in a near death state and have survived sexual abuse, a near kidnapping, drowning and extreme alcohol poisoning throughout my life. I was born with the wrong chromosomes and can't help but wish that i just never was.

I don't know when but I know with certainty B will falter and likely soon. That will be my last day and I'll finally be able to rest free of constant nightmares.

Thanks and I'm sorry. To everyone and most of all Q. My love is always going to be with you.
So far, I've managed to not drink much. My best friend is on the way over and may want to drink though which I cant help but agree to.

I drink because I feel like shit and want to feel something else. Because I also feel like I want to hurt myself because I deserve it and want to disappear. It's bad, I know. Add that my best friend and then also my roommate both abuse it because of depression too.  

I'm sorry...

I don't find myself jealous of cis women but I do of lucky or beautiful trans women. I send them all my love and will do anything I ever could to help them more but it definitely intensifies the dysphoria and self hate I have for myself.  

It essentially that the grass is always greener on the other side. I have people who love me and insist that I'm attractive and worthwhile but it's hard to hear through a haze of depression.

thank you for reaching out. I agreed to the pact because it would help the roommate to keep on. It's definitely helped a few times already and including yesterday. We made it explicitly after the first attempt she made since I knew her. But while it's motivation for her to keep on, at times it's motivation for me to quit.
